title: How To Plaster A Wall | Skim Coat Plastering [Plastering Tutorial]
description:
If you are new to plastering and want to learn how to plaster a wall, this video is for you!

I've been plastering professionally for just over a decade now and in that time have developed a set of methods and techniques that provide reliable and consistently good results. This how to video is aimed at beginners and people who are new to the trade of plastering and would like to know the basics for learning how to plaster a wall. 

Learn everything you need to know about plastering a wall, from the correct mixing consistency of the plaster to timing the trowels, to be ready to skim your first wall. 

Learning how to plaster a wall is not easy, in fact, there is no easy way to plaster a wall, but without guidance it's almost impossible. Please feel free to comment any plastering questions below if you guys have any.

I hope you've enjoyed this video on how to plaster a wall and remember to subscribe if you enjoyed this plastering video! #plastering
